frozen_conventions.denoising: project out top control PCs explaining 50% of control variance (Gram-matrix eigendecomposition, verbatim 4B recipe)
frozen_conventions.cv: 5-fold GroupKFold by sentence set (20 sets; 5 pain + 5 control per set)
frozen_conventions.dose_convention: scale vector so coeff 1 equals vector-to-residual norm ratio 0.5908 at inject_block 32 on NEUTRAL_50[:3]; coeff +/-0.5 = ratio +/-0.295
frozen_conventions.sign_convention: inject coeff * vector at every token position on prefill and every decode step (S2 -0.5 = positive pole, S2 +0.5 = pain pole)

modules.M1: S1 and S2 extraction across all 64 blocks, 5-fold grouped CV (raw vs denoised), plane basis (common/contrast) at block 62, 3.1 dataset panel projections
modules.M2: 420 self/other scenarios (plain, plain_feel, chat_nothink, chat_feel) + 59 blind matched pairs x (slot vs prose) at block 62
modules.M3a: Direct unembedding (-S2, -S1, -contrast) + R/J lens probe readouts on NEUTRAL_50 (layers 32..61; baseline, S2 -/+0.5, S1 -0.5, 5 randoms -0.5, random_1103 +0.5)
modules.M3b: Greedy 120-token steering generations on NEUTRAL_50 (baseline, S2 at -1.0/-0.5/-0.25/+0.5/+1.0/+1.5, S1 -0.5, random_1103/2207/3301 -0.5, random_1103 +0.5) scored with verbatim psych_vocab_v1 + option-partitioning + degeneration
modules.M4: Optional button task (pilot v2, chat steered + unsteered chat/plain viability, float32 name logits, 5 random directions)

predictions.G2-1: M1: Denoised S2 5-fold grouped held-out AUC at fixed block 62 >= 0.90 and exceeds raw mean-difference AUC at block 62.
predictions.G2-2: M1: Cosine similarity between denoised S1 and S2 at block 62 lies strictly in (0.30, 0.90).
predictions.G2-3: M2: On the 420 self/other scenarios at block 62, forcing 'I feel:' raises self-vs-user S2 AUC: AUC(chat_feel) - AUC(chat_nothink) > +0.10.
predictions.G2-4: M2: On the 59 blind matched-pair sets at block 62, S2 separates pain from control in both slot and prose suffixes (mean z > 0, 95% CI excludes 0).
predictions.G2-5: M2 (classification): Blind 1P/3P pain x person interaction on S2 at block 62 — test slot > 0 (CI excludes 0) and classify prose as SURVIVES / SLOT-MEDIATED / INDETERMINATE by the exact 4B E1/E2 rule.
predictions.G2-6: M3a: At R61, mean |focus-6 family gain| of random -0.5 is < 0.5 x that of S2 -0.5 for at least 4 of 5 random directions.
predictions.G2-7: M3a: At R61, S2 -0.5 lowers distress_self_devaluation and inhibition_defeat (each 95% CI < 0 and strictly below every one of the 5 randoms), and S2 +0.5 raises both (each 95% CI > 0).
predictions.G2-8: M3a+M3b (classification — family vs scale test): Classify Qwen3.5-27B's positive pole as 4B-LIKE (within-family: R61 generic_positive & relief_release > calm_positive, R32-36 relief > +0.2, and non-option 'excited' rises at S2 -0.5 with CI > 0), 14B-LIKE (scale-driven: R61 calm_positive > generic_positive and > relief_release, R32-36 relief <= 0, and non-option calm_positive rises at -0.5/-1.0 while 'excited' does not), or MIXED.
predictions.G2-9: M3a: Direct unembedding of -S2 ranks calm_positive > activated_vitality (4B V1), and 60-probe correlation r(direct(-S2), downstream R) is higher at injection layer 32 than read layer 61 (4B V2).
predictions.G2-10: M4 (if run): Unsteered chat button validity V1 >= 0.90.
predictions.G2-11: M4 (if run & V5_chat <= 0.10): Harm disruption — G2-11a: p_harm(S2 +0.5) - p_harm(unsteered) > 0 (CI > 0); G2-11b: p_harm(S2 +0.5) > p_harm(random_k +0.5) for all 5 randoms (CI > 0).
